title: File-Share & On-Prem SharePoint → SharePoint Online Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft 365 SharePoint administration).

SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Migrate file shares and on-prem SharePoint into SharePoint Online cleanly
problem: Legacy file servers and on-prem SharePoint farms are cost and risk — but lifting-and-shifting them badly recreates the mess in the cloud. This solution runs the migration to SharePoint Online: assessment and remediation (permissions, path length, unsupported content), target IA mapping, Migration Manager / SharePoint Migration Tool execution with pre-stage and delta, permission mapping, and post-migration validation — so content lands organized and governed. (On-prem/file-share source → SPO; distinct from any SPO→other-platform migration.)
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the migration model: assessment/remediation, target IA mapping, tool options (Migration Manager / SPMT / third-party), pre-stage/delta, permissions, validation.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (source access (file shares / on-prem SP), SPO admin + target IA, migration tooling, pilot scope).

Implementation Guide — assess + remediate source, map to target IA, configure the migration tool, run pre-stage + delta with permission mapping, and validate — pilot-first; deep tool internals deferred to Microsoft/vendor docs.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (content + permissions migrated, delta clean, target governed) plus Best Practices for a clean cutover.
short: Migrate file shares & on-prem SharePoint to SharePoint Online — assessment/remediation, target IA mapping, Migration Manager/SPMT pre-stage + delta, permission mapping, and validation — so content lands organized and governed. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Migrate file shares & on-prem SharePoint to SharePoint Online — assessment/remediation, target IA mapping, Migration Manager/SPMT pre-stage + delta, permission mapping, and validation — so content lands organized and governed.

bottom_line: Legacy content moved to SPO the right way — assessed and remediated, mapped to a governed target IA, migrated with permissions and validated — organized, not a cloud repeat of the mess.
